name: Amam
overview: Amam is identified as a city within the territory of Judah, specifically mentioned alongside other towns such as Shema and Moladah (Joshua 15:26). The city is also associated with the tribe of Simeon, whose inheritance was located within the borders of Judah (Joshua 19:1). This suggests that Amam was situated in a district originally assigned to Judah but later recognized as part of Simeon's inheritance (Joshua 19:2-5). These passages highlight the historical and geographical relationship between the tribes of Judah and Simeon in the Promised Land.
